faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept most major PPO dental insurance plans including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, and United Concordia. Call us to verify your specific coverage before your visit.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can request an appointment using the form on our Contact page, call us at (619) 555-0182, or chat with our assistant below. We'll confirm your appointment within one business day.

faqs.question: What are your hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency dental care?
faqs.answer: Yes! We reserve same-day slots for dental emergencies. If you're experiencing a toothache, broken tooth, or other urgent issue, call us first thing in the morning.

faqs.question: Is teeth whitening safe?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our professional whitening treatments are safe, effective, and supervised by our dentists. Over-the-counter products can cause sensitivity — our in-office treatment minimizes that risk.

faqs.question: Do you see children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome patients of all ages. Our pediatric dental care is designed to make kids feel comfortable and build good habits early.

about: Founded in 2008 by Dr. Maria Santos, Sunset Dental has been serving the San Diego community with compassionate, high-quality dental care for over 15 years. Our state-of-the-art Ocean View Boulevard facility combines the latest dental technology with a warm, welcoming environment — because we believe great dental care should never feel intimidating. Whether you're coming in for a routine cleaning or a complete smile transformation, our team is here to make you feel at home.

team.name: Dr. Maria Santos
team.bio: Dr. Santos completed her dental degree at UCSF School of Dentistry and brings over 18 years of experience in general and cosmetic dentistry. She founded Sunset Dental with a simple mission: treat every patient like family.

team.name: Dr. James Park
team.bio: Specializing in implants and oral surgery, Dr. Park brings precision and a gentle touch to even the most complex procedures. He completed his residency at UC San Diego Medical Center.

team.name: Lisa Nguyen
team.bio: With 10 years of experience and a genuine passion for patient education, Lisa helps every patient leave with a healthier smile and the knowledge to maintain it.
